name: velvet_atlas
theme: a fabric micro-world that never leaves the cloth — a royal-blue velvet evening coat on a dress-form, down through its goldwork and twill to a dyed fiber's dye crystals, folding back out as quilted-lining country and home to the atelier

registers.name: atelier
registers.scene: a tailor's atelier at night seen from across the room at standing height, empty, no one present, a headless dress-form at the center wearing a royal-blue velvet evening coat, gold embroidery banding one sleeve at the wrist, brass lamps along the panelled walls, bolts of cloth stacked on a long cutting table, deep shadow in the corners
registers.target: the coat's cuff, a wide band of gold bullion embroidery coiled in tight scrolls over royal-blue velvet
registers.loop_target: a tailor's atelier at night, a dress-form wearing a royal-blue velvet coat under brass lamps, seen from across the room

registers.name: gold_cuff
registers.scene: the coat's cuff at full width, heavy gold bullion embroidery coiled in tight scrolls and knots, raised metal thread bright under the lamps, panels of royal-blue velvet bare between the goldwork
registers.target: a bare panel of blue velvet between the gold scrolls, its surface ribbed with fine diagonal rows

registers.name: twill_weave
registers.scene: the twill weave beneath the embroidery, thick indigo thread ridges crossing over and under in strict diagonal rows, narrow shadowed valleys between every ridge, stray blue floss laid across the ranks
registers.target: a single blue fiber clear of one ridge, a slender strand shingled with overlapping scale plates

registers.name: dyed_fiber
registers.scene: the surface of a single dyed fiber, shingled in overlapping scale plates, stepped platelets of dye crystal clinging along every edge in hot violet terraces

registers.name: quilted_country
registers.scene: a wide country of quilted coat lining, padded royal-blue diamonds standing as low rounded hills, gold stitching running the ridgelines in long straight seams, a warm lamplit hollow low between the hills

music_theme: hushed velvet chamber music, plucked harp and low bowed strings under a soft gold shimmer, one deep bloom of sound landing on the dye-crystal seam
